bearerAuth.description: Live developer API key (`lfm_live_…`) from an authoring-enabled organization.

forceNew.description: When true, start a new publish job even if this project already has clothes or hair for the same image. Omit to reuse a matching ready or in-progress plate.
When true, start a new publish job even if this project already has clothes or hair for the same image. Omit to reuse a matching ready or in-progress plate.
When true, start a new location publish job even if this project already has a location for the same image. Omit to reuse a matching published or in-progress location.

gender.description: Optional. Omit to inherit gender from the avatar catalogue.

age.description: Optional apparent age in years (1–1000). Omit to inherit from the avatar catalogue.

ethnicity.description: Optional appearance group for facial features, hair, and skin colour. Omit to inherit from the avatar catalogue.

gender.description: Set a gender override, or null to inherit from the avatar catalogue again.

age.description: Set an apparent age override (1–1000), or null to inherit from the avatar catalogue again.

ethnicity.description: Set an appearance-group override for facial features, hair, and skin colour, or null to inherit from the avatar catalogue again.
